facts.verdict: Send with the listed fixes. All five tiles on the sheet are the right pictures (pixel match, with the black crop in the same window), and most claims hold: the site picture must come down, the new horn is dark on its left and along its top, the far horn is dark, the version without the lit back looks like black glass, and about an hour is fair for a full render. But the draft gets wrong how the site's gold horn was faked, says the ceiling spot shows only up close although it is visible on this sheet, overstates what lighting the whole back would do, calls a bar ceiling spot a photo light, and leaves out the lights skeptic's warning that the far light must move about a foot and be tested first.

problems.quote: If you want the whole horn lemon, there are two honest ways:
problems.why: Neither way is shown to make the whole horn lemon. The message itself says the first way leaves the left fifth dark, and no critic tested the head-on view. He would ask for something nobody can deliver.
problems.fix: If you want more of the horn lemon, there are two honest ways:

It is real light bouncing off the glossy bar top, which the old picture's settings left out (b62 README: the wall went from 27.5 to 37.5 with only that change, and fixed-8 reads 37.2).

reader.verdict: Send with the listed fixes. The recommendation and the "new"/"without" ask are sound and match both critics, but the draft overstates three things ("the whole horn lemon", "an eighth wider", "show only up close"), softens the three placement slips ("photo lights … couldn't quite"), and never explains the brighter record wall he will notice first in the top pair. Cut the layout sentence and the black-glass sentence, add one line on the record wall, end on the ask, and relabel "full size" as "close up" on the sheet.
